```{r}

orthos <- read.table("Orthogroups/Orthogroups.tsv", 
                     sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# Présence/absence : cellule non vide = 1, vide = 0
orthos_bin <- as.data.frame((orthos != "") * 1)


upset(
  orthos_bin,
  nsets = ncol(orthos_bin),
  nintersects = 120,
)
```

## Pan-génomique ?

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Lire Orthogroups.tsv
orthos <- read.table(
  "Orthogroups/Orthogroups.tsv",
  sep = "\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

# présence/absence
orthos_bin <- (orthos != "") * 1

# Nombre d'espèces total
N <- ncol(orthos_bin)

# Fréquence par orthogroupe = nb d'espèces où présent
freq <- rowSums(orthos_bin)

# Seuil softcore > 90%
softcore_cutoff <- ceiling(0.9 * N)  # pour N=21 -> 19

# Catégories pan-génome
cat <- ifelse(freq == N, "Core",
       ifelse(freq >= softcore_cutoff, "Softcore",
       ifelse(freq == 1, "Private", "Dispensable")))

df <- data.frame(
  Orthogroup = rownames(orthos_bin),
  freq = freq,
  category = factor(cat, levels = c("Private", "Dispensable", "Softcore", "Core"))
)


df$freq_pct <- 100 * df$freq / N

ggplot(df, aes(x = freq, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, N, by = 1)) +
  labs(x = paste0("Frequency (#species, N=", N, ")"),
       y = "Number of orthogroups",
       fill = "Class") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    Private = "#AA4466",
    Dispensable = "#6699CC",
    Softcore = "#009E73",
    Core = "#E69F00"
  )) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}

# table de comptage par fréquence et catégorie
bar_df <- df %>%
  count(freq, category) %>%
  tidyr::complete(freq = 1:N, category, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(freq) %>%
  mutate(total_freq = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = freq, y = n, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  # affiche le total au-dessus de chaque barre (somme des catégories)
  geom_text(
    data = bar_df %>% distinct(freq, total_freq),
    aes(x = freq, y = total_freq, label = total_freq),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:N) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    Private = "#AA4466",
    Dispensable = "#6699CC",
    Softcore = "#009E73",
    Core = "#E69F00"
  )) +
  labs(x = paste0("Frequency (#species, N=", N, ")"),
       y = "Number of orthogroups",
       fill = "Class") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5))
```
